Padi per kapita = produksi (juta ton) ÷: Rice per capita = production (million tons) ÷ population (million people) × 1,000. Score = min(100, 4 × per capita percentage decrease + 13 × positive temperature anomaly + 0.55 × absolute value of rainfall change). Temperature and rain changes are demo inputs without an observation baseline. Score <30 is low, 30–54 is alert, ≥55 is high. This illustrative formula has not been trained or validated, and does not assess the adequacy of rice consumption.

The infographic scenario applies total growth of +1.56% for rice and +9.06% for population in six years, compounded, to each country. This is an adaptation of the infographic's growth assumptions.
